g.text: SSH-agent topology — post eng#295 proxy-only cutover (Linux)
Workstation — the only host with a PIV card
is-ssh-host — no card; agent arrives forwarded
varies and it dies with the TCP
NEVER lists it, so the latch is
(#3 when reached via posh, #2 on plain `ssh host`)
workstation's piggy). Degrade serves whichever is
live; first-wins dedup lists the shared key once.
SSH_AUTH_SOCK = the posh endpoint; eng sets it = the mux
host-globally. Both set it in a posh session — precedence
is env-order today. Decide: mux as sole front (posh stops
self-exporting on eng hosts), or posh keeps its direct
export and the mux covers only non-posh sessions.
PIGGY_AUTH_SOCK, so a bare run probes #2 (card-backed),
not the mux. Define the mux-targeting invocation
